week_story: Revenue rose 3% to $53.7K. Octaspring Queen sold 43 units vs 34 (+26%) and made half of sales.
Twin & XL sales fell 38% (13 units vs 20) and Pillows sold 1 unit vs 8, with the True Evolution pillow at 0 available.
refunds: Refunds were $4,062 (12.0% refund rate), down from $5,908 last week. Queen ($1,381) and King ($1,107) toppers had the largest; net payout rose to $29.5K.
pacing_reco: November is at $61.4K through Nov 8, 22% behind the same days last year ($79.2K). Queen stock and BF/CM deals are the levers to close it.
ads_context: Ad spend fell 8% to $3,860 while ad sales rose 5% to $37,151.
ACoS improved to 10.4% (from 11.9%) and TACoS to 7.2% (from 8.0%); ads drove 69% of revenue.
